summary: A brutally difficult, deeply thematic cooperative survival game where every turn is an agonizing trade-off between exploring, gathering food, building shelter, and resting, all while a deck of events actively works to kill you. Its action-selection system (committing workers before seeing outcomes, then resolving with dice and risky discovery tokens) makes even simple actions feel tense and consequential.
praised: Exceptional theme integration where mechanics genuinely simulate desperate survival
Tense, meaningful decisions every round with real risk of a character dying
High replayability from modular scenarios, adventure decks, and companion app content
Strong solo mode that plays two characters
criticised: Steep rulebook and heavy upkeep/bookkeeping each round
Punishing difficulty and swingy dice/event luck can undo careful planning
Long setup and playtime, with a slow first game or two while learning
Some scenarios feel unbalanced or overly harsh compared to others

interaction.kind: cooperative planning and resource allocation, with limited direct interaction beyond assigning shared actions

scoring.why: The game is won or lost as a team by surviving the scenario's specific objective (e.g., building a shelter, defeating a beast, escaping the island) before morale or health runs out, not by accumulating points

similar: First Martians: Adventures on the Red Planet
